note: Editable rules for source-finder layer 3 (Jerome). Like ledger-allowlist.json, this is data, not code: change a number or a pattern here and the next run uses it. Patterns are regular expressions matched against the page text after lowercasing and removing accents, and only when they appear within `window` characters of the subject's name. Layer 3 finds EVIDENCE for a person to look at; it never proves anything, and when unsure it asks (review). Items marked PROVISIONAL are Claude's starting values and have not been confirmed by Tom.

sufficiency._note: CONFIRMED: Tom wants plenty of material, judged by quality not by number of sites. minWords is the floor (ready); targetWords is the goal (Jerome runs a second allowlist search until it is reached or the fetch caps run out; below it a ready entry is flagged thin_material). Both count only SUBSTANTIVE pages: verify-capable pages where the subject's name appears at least minMentionsPerPage times. targetWords (4000) and minMentionsPerPage (3) are PROVISIONAL. CONFIRMED in principle: one verify-capable source can be enough. minWordsVerifyCapable is PROVISIONAL (about twice the target article length). newSubjectMinDomains is PROVISIONAL: raise to 2 to require two independent verify-capable websites before a brand-new subject (for example a visitor suggestion) can proceed. Reported-tier and unjudged pages never count toward this.

_genericNameWords: Words skipped when choosing the part of a name that evidence must appear near (so "Miracle of Lanciano" is anchored on "lanciano"). PROVISIONAL starter list.

scandal._note: CONFIRMED: scandals go to review. This list is only a net for obvious names (checked against the subject's name, not the page text). Whether an entry IS a scandal is a judgment; the real recognition is Ignatius's job later. PROVISIONAL starter list for Tom to edit.

s.label: Saint
s._note: CONFIRMED: three bases. A basis counts only if its evidence appears near the saint's name on a source that can verify. PROVISIONAL: the pattern lists and the year limits.

notCanonized._note: Used only when NO basis was found. Signals that the person may be Blessed, Venerable or a Servant of God: review, reason 'not canonized'.
